scope: sampled visual and story review; ASR and measured signal support; no validated audio listening
product_from_film: TAL by Grapevine is a chat-based job-search assistant that suggests roles and helps with interview preparation and salary requests.
explains_well: One job seeker and one continuing chat connect job suggestions, interview preparation and negotiation advice.
unclear: The story jumps from an Apply option to an interview confirmation without showing the application details or submission.
scenario: Help Priya find a business-analyst role, prepare for Splice and ask for a higher salary.
product_clear_basis: The app-store view says Tal finds your next job; the role cards later show how.

scenes.action: A distressed woman sits in a cafe in black-and-white footage. A booklet says I’M TAL and Stop job hunting like the 90s. She reads it; the footage becomes color and an app-store view says Tal finds your next job.
scenes.design: Monochrome cafe, printed fox mascot and warm color reveal.
scenes.purpose: Introduce the assistant through a character’s frustration and discovery.
scenes.evidence: Visible chronological 1 fps samples, source 0–15s; boundary approximate; exact motion between samples unverified.

scenes.action: Priya opens a chat. She describes exhaustion, many applications without callbacks and a manager taking credit. Tal answers that she is misplaced rather than lost and offers to fix it. A clock and home-sofa shots mark the passage of time.
scenes.design: Orange and white chat bubbles on a patterned background, warm room and reaction shots.
scenes.purpose: Establish needs through a conversational exchange.
scenes.evidence: Visible chronological 1 fps samples, source 15–35s; boundary approximate; exact motion between samples unverified.

scenes.action: Role cards include a strategy-and-insights business analyst role and Splice payments intelligence, with pay ranges and Apply, Not interested and Send me another role controls. Tal asks what she wants mornings to feel like. She interacts with the phone and smiles.
scenes.design: Readable role cards and orange action buttons.
scenes.purpose: Turn frustration into choices tied to work preferences.
scenes.evidence: Visible chronological 1 fps samples, source 35–50s; boundary approximate; exact motion between samples unverified.

scenes.action: A Splice interview-confirmation email notification appears. Tal supplies commonly asked questions reported on Grapevine, including diagnosing a flat signup funnel and payment metrics. Priya reads and considers them.
scenes.design: Email notification and close chat views.
scenes.purpose: Carry the selected employer into interview preparation.
scenes.evidence: Visible chronological 1 fps samples, source 50–67s; boundary approximate; exact motion between samples unverified.

scenes.action: Priya takes notes at a desk, continues the chat and gets advice to explain her approach before metrics. Tal offers voice notes; she walks while a recording-style bar appears. Later notifications ask if she is ready and announce interview day.
scenes.design: Desk notes, phone conversation, microphone-like control and orange waveform bar.
scenes.purpose: Show preparation extending beyond text into a daily routine.
scenes.evidence: Visible chronological 1 fps samples, source 67–85s; boundary approximate; exact motion between samples unverified.

scenes.action: Dressed for the interview, Priya asks how to request a 20% salary increase. Tal uses her three years of data experience to suggest wording. She walks outside; We got this appears across the chat and her portrait.
scenes.design: Blue blazer, close message text and large warm slogan.
scenes.purpose: End the character’s arc with confidence and specific negotiation language, not a shown job offer.
scenes.evidence: Visible chronological 1 fps samples, source 85–100s; boundary approximate; exact motion between samples unverified.

scenes.action: An orange brand card introduces Tal by Grapevine and the fox character with The Right Job In Your DMs. The cafe returns in black and white with another frustrated person finding the same booklet, then color returns as he uses the app.
scenes.design: Orange mascot card and repeated cafe setup.
scenes.purpose: Turn the first story into a repeatable discovery loop.
scenes.evidence: Visible chronological 1 fps samples, source 100–118s; boundary approximate; exact motion between samples unverified.

scenes.action: A Grapevine product card leads to available-now text with app-store platform icons.
scenes.design: Dark end cards and small white type.
scenes.purpose: Give the product family and availability.
scenes.evidence: Visible chronological 1 fps samples, source 118–121.16s; boundary approximate; exact motion between samples unverified.

lessons.keep: Carry one named person and one concrete opportunity through multiple assistant capabilities.
lessons.avoid: Avoid skipping the action that connects a recommendation to the claimed next-stage result.
lessons.open: Application handling, matching inputs, employer and interview data, outcomes, voice-note content and all audio remain unverified.
try: For Tin, keep one campaign visible while the assistant researches, drafts and prepares the launch.
Show the submission or publish confirmation before jumping to a later success notification.
